### Root Cause
In [`Frequency.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_75_group_c_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/stat/Frequency.java), the deprecated method `getPct(Object v)` erroneously delegated to `getCumPct((Comparable<?>) v)` instead of `getPct((Comparable<?>) v)`, returning the cumulative percentage rather than the frequency percentage for the given object.

### Solution
- Updated [`Frequency.getPct(Object)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_75_group_c_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/stat/Frequency.java#L301-L305) to call `getPct((Comparable<?>) v)`.
- Verified the fix passes the Cucumber BDD test suite as well as the unit tests.
- Saved the patch file to `negative_fix.patch`.
